one_liner: Cloud platform for web applications, serverless computing, and deployments, offering a REST API and official MCP server.
access_notes: Free self-serve account creation grants access to generate personal access tokens and use the API.
verdict_reason: Netlify provides a well-documented REST API, OpenAPI specifications, self-serve personal access tokens, OAuth2 support, and an official MCP server.

evidence.snippet: Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication. All requests must use HTTPS.
To authenticate API requests, include the token in the authorization header: Authorization: Bearer
Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps
You can browse the OpenAPI reference for the Netlify API to explore available endpoints.
